domain: digital technologies or AI in healthcare
description: Researcher studying paradoxes arising from the implementation of digital technologies and AI in healthcare settings, with a focus on management strategies to navigate these paradoxes. Employs qualitative research methods.

rating_rules.🟢🟢🟢: 高度相关：直接涉及 healthcare + digital/AI + paradox/management，且明确欢迎质性研究
rating_rules.🟢🟢: 中度相关：涉及 healthcare + digital/AI，或涉及 paradox/management + 期刊对质性友好
rating_rules.🟢: 低度相关：涉及 healthcare 或 AI/digital，但需要较强的 reframing 才能适配
rating_rules.🟡: 可能相关：需要创造性的重新框架才能适配，且期刊可能接受；需在 analysis 中详细说明 reframing 策略
rating_rules.🔴: 不相关：与 healthcare AI paradox 距离太远，或期刊方法论完全不匹配（如纯数学建模）
